description: val5-order-01: two WEEKNUM stale-state readers, B2 and C2, of the same precedent A2 (a Sunday marker); A1 above is a Monday marker. No FVSCHEDULE. WEEKNUM(2,99) is 1 after the Sunday marker and 2 after the Monday marker, so (B2, C2) = (1, 1) if both readers run right after A2, (1, 2) if only the reader next to A2 does, (2, 1) if only the farther one does, (2, 2) if neither does. A reader joins WEEKNUM(2..7,99): 111111 after a Sunday marker (return_type 1), 222222 after a Monday marker (2), 122222 after a Tuesday marker (12) (dates.md "WEEKNUM's stale `return_type` state"; the decoding of probes/weeknum-stale-dependency). Raw values only; do not add cells or sheets: where each formula sits is the experiment. No expected values: the case is written to tell four candidate rules apart.
